metadata.title: Field Guide to Document Structures
metadata.description: Definition lists, blockquotes, code, and ordered lists for extraction fidelity.

blocks.text: This page exercises the block types that long-form technical writing relies on: a definition list, a block quotation, an ordered procedure, an unordered checklist, and preformatted configuration text.

Capture
The act of recording what a page rendered for an authorized reader, without altering its substance.
Bundle
The machine-readable companion to the PDF: text, structure, chunks, and provenance in one directory.
Sentinel
A string that exists only inside a raster, so its presence in the text proves recognition ran.

blocks.text: Preserve the reading order first. A beautiful page that reads in the wrong order is a worse record than a plain page that reads correctly.

Wait for the page's readiness signal before touching the DOM.
Record every structure the page used to say what it said.
Validate the result before publishing anything.
